description: This file contains the implementation of the Uri class that represents and manipulates URI objects in accordance with PSR-7 standards. It provides methods for parsing, constructing, and modifying URIs, including handling of scheme, host, port, path, query, and fragment components.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Implements the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing an immutable value object for URI manipulation with methods to access and modify URI components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new URI object, optionally parsing a URI string into its components.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Prepares object clone operations, resetting cached URI string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the URI object into its string representation, constructing the URI string from components.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the URI scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority component of the URI, including user info, host, and port.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user information component of the URI.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host component of the URI.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port component if non-standard, otherwise null.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path component of the URI.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the query string.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Returns the fragment component.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified user info and optional password.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified host.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified query.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new URI instance with the specified fragment.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Parses the input URI string into its components and sets the respective properties.

methods.name: createUriString
methods.description: Constructs a URI string from individual components.

methods.name: isNonStandardPort
methods.description: Determines if a port number is non-standard for the given scheme and host.

methods.name: filterScheme
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates the scheme component.

methods.name: filterUserInfoPart
methods.description: Encodes and filters a user info part of the URI.

methods.name: filterPath
methods.description: Encodes and filters the path component of the URI.

methods.name: filterInvalidUtf8
methods.description: Encodes invalid UTF-8 sequences within strings.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Encodes and filters the query string.

methods.name: splitQueryValue
methods.description: Splits a query string element into key and value.

methods.name: filterFragment
methods.description: Encodes and filters the fragment component.

methods.name: filterQueryOrFragment
methods.description: Filters a query or fragment string component.

methods.name: urlEncodeChar
methods.description: Encodes a regex match into URL-encoded form.
